original_test_intent: Verify all SMBIOS Type 8 connector metadata and internal/external endpoint mappings against the board specification and across reboot.
original_method: Capture every full Type 8 record with DMI metadata, map records using designators plus handle/order and connector types, compare five fields including legitimate blanks, reboot under approval/recovery, then repeat and diff the complete connector inventory.
manual_activity: Owner supplies the connector map and allowed blank/type values, approves reboot and provides recovery; no physical port action belongs to this row.
safety_requirements: Do not suppress errors or bypass target authentication
Do not infer physical port function or perform hotplug
Stop on missing/ambiguous record or boot failure
agent_execution_scope: Validate connector oracle and blank policy
Map records with stable composite identity
Report metadata coverage only without final verdict
engineer_actions: Define blank endpoint and stable mapping rules

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `dmidecode -t 8` is correct, but `grep -iA1 "Port Connector Record"` may miss the usual section label and cannot collect five fields or multiple records; unsafe SSH and hidden errors make it unsuitable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture every complete Type 8 record before and after an approved reboot, map by designators plus DMI metadata while retaining blanks, and compare against the board connector specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All five named fields, correctness, pre/post comparison, reboot persistence and 5/5-minute timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Represent each connector as an internal endpoint, external endpoint and port semantic keyed by stable DMI metadata, with explicit null rather than omitted designators.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete inventory and null-aware stable matching instead of a header snippet.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing connectors, swapped endpoint labels, wrong type vocabulary and reboot drift without claiming electrical function.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS metadata can be incomplete or stale; physical link tests are separate and cannot be inferred from Type 8 alone.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must define the expected connector inventory and accepted vocabulary/blank endpoints. This row cannot be broadened into physical hotplug or link validation.
expected_evidence: No physical-function or hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently specifies Type 8 metadata fields and reboot persistence; no physical operation is requested.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The connector map, mapping/vocabulary policy, decoder and reboot controls are finite inputs; absence delays execution rather than review.

review_improvement: Prevents a truncated or nonmatching heading grep from passing a multi-record connector inventory or being mistaken for a port function test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 8 describes connector metadata, not electrical behavior. Multiple records can have blank one-sided designators, so complete null-aware mapping is required before comparison. Collection is automatable but the required reboot is service-impacting, making REQUIRES correct while preserving the metadata-only boundary.
